title: Capture consent from user
gherkin:
Feature: Independent consent capture
  Scenario: User provides consent
    Given the user is presented with a consent form
    When the user reads the consent form
    And the user selects the 'I agree' option
    Then the user's consent should be recorded successfully
rationale: To verify that the system can successfully capture consent from the user when they agree to the terms.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the requirement of independent consent capture, ensuring that the process of obtaining consent is clear and adheres to specified criteria.

title: Reject consent from user
gherkin:
Feature: Independent consent capture
  Scenario: User declines consent
    Given the user is presented with a consent form
    When the user reads the consent form
    And the user selects the 'I do not agree' option
    Then the user's consent should not be recorded
rationale: To ensure that the system does not record consent if the user declines it.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the requirement of independent consent capture, ensuring that the process of obtaining consent is clear and adheres to specified criteria.
